requests: Whether rockwool Conformboard panels, or other non-foam or natural alternatives, can be fixed under the rafters like the foam panel shown, moving the envelope up while keeping the roof vented.
Whether strapping can be used to secure those panels.
reason: The reply directly answers the core question: yes, rigid or netted rockwool can go under the rafters, with an added vapor barrier if the space is to be conditioned or habitable. It also covers vapor-barrier placement, cost trade-offs, venting-gap options and the limits of natural vapor-barrier materials. It does not explicitly address strapping or name other natural insulation materials, but these are minor details within an otherwise affirmative and complete answer.
